description: This file defines a React component for a user interface modal to add a pass-through endpoint, including form handling, UI elements, and API interaction logic.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Resets form and local states, then closes the modal.

methods.name: handlePathChange
methods.description: Formats the path prefix; adds leading slash if missing.

methods.name: addPassThrough
methods.description: Handles form submission; calls API to create endpoint and updates UI state.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies provided text to clipboard and shows notification.
